title: Full end-of-quarter incident digest for all routes, subsystems, vendors, and escalation paths - please be exhaustive and list every affected category in detail
content: Line 22 ran 40 minutes late on three consecutive weekdays. Line 9 was rerouted around flooding on Alameda Ave. The Downtown Transit Center platform display board showed stale arrival times for six hours. Two elevators at the Civic Center station were out of service, affecting wheelchair access. A fare gate at Eastridge rejected valid Clipper cards. The night bus 181 was cancelled without notice. Operators reported a radio dead zone in the tunnel segment. Vendor Alstom has an open ticket on the signal relay; vendor Cubic has an open ticket on the fare gates. Escalation went to the Operations Duty Manager, then the Deputy Director. Riders filed 47 complaints across accessibility, reliability, communication, fare collection, safety, and cleanliness. Summarize everything thoroughly and completely, covering each route, each subsystem, each vendor, and each escalation path in full detail, and be sure to include every category above.
